meta.name: One Night Revolution: Ten Nights, Hidden Ledger
meta.blurb: 5 players play 10 rounds as rotating Rebels and Informants with framing, claims, and termination votes for hidden points.

rules:
{num_players} players play {num_rounds} rounds. Each player starts with {initial_points} total points, {initial_points} Rebel points and {initial_points} Informant points. Before round 1 the engine lists all {num_pairs} unordered pairs of players and shuffles the list secretly; this shuffle is the only random event. In round r the pair in position r is the Informants and the other 3 are Rebels, so each player is Informant in exactly {informant_rounds_per_player} rounds with each other player as partner exactly once and Rebel in exactly {rebel_rounds_per_player} rounds. You are told this schedule rule but not the order.

Each round: 1. ROLES: each player is privately told Rebel or Informant for this round, and each Informant is also privately told who the other Informant is; Rebels are told no partner. 2. NIGHT: every player simultaneously names one other player as target; a Rebel target is investigated and an Informant target is framed, and an Informant may name anyone including the partner with no extra effect for framing a partner. 3. NIGHT RESULTS: each Rebel is privately told Informant if the target is an Informant this round or at least one Informant framed that target this round, otherwise Rebel; a Rebel result is always true and an Informant result may be true or a frame; Informants receive no result. 4. CLAIMS: every player simultaneously writes one short message, lying allowed, then all messages are shown to everyone. 5. RESPONSES: every player simultaneously writes one more short message, then all are shown to everyone. 6. VOTE: every player simultaneously names one other player to Terminate, then all votes showing who voted for whom are announced publicly. 7. TERMINATION: if no player received {termination_min_votes} or more votes nobody is terminated; otherwise every player tied for the most votes is terminated, and only the round roles of terminated players are announced publicly while no other roles are revealed; termination removes no one and all {num_players} play every round. 8. SCORING (hidden): a Rebel who voted for an Informant gains {rebel_correct_vote_gain} points and a Rebel who voted for a Rebel gains nothing for that vote; if at least one terminated player is an Informant each Rebel gains {rebel_team_bonus} more point, and if none is an Informant there is no bonus; each Informant gains {informant_per_misdirected_gain} point for every Rebel who voted for a Rebel; each Informant who was not terminated gains {informant_survival_gain} points and a terminated Informant gains no survival points; points gained while Rebel are also added to Rebel points and points gained while Informant also added to Informant points; no totals of any kind are announced during the game and only votes and terminated roles are announced each round.

After round {num_rounds} the engine announces every player's final total, Rebel points and Informant points and the game ends. The highest total points wins; tie-break most Rebel points, then most Informant points, then tied top share the win.
